neighbours.label: the slot right after a verb of correspondence (reflects this/it, keep pace with, correspond with, mirrors)
fire: The gloomy lighting of the play reflects this sense of loss.
Wages have failed to keep pace with the price of housing.
Shipments were cut to correspond with the slowdown in orders.
The quiet ending of the novel reflects it perfectly.
Teacher numbers must keep pace with the growth in pupils.
The new seating plan mirrors the band's relaxed attitude.
Should the budget not reflect this change in priorities?
Staff hours were adjusted to correspond with the shorter opening times.
quiet: The gloomy lighting of the play was designed by a student.
Wages have risen slowly over the past twenty years.
Shipments were cut sharply during the long winter.
The quiet ending of the novel surprised many readers.
Teacher numbers have grown in most parts of the region.
The new seating plan was printed on the back of the ticket.
Should the budget not be published before the meeting?
Staff hours were posted on the board near the kitchen.

notes: Probe: 'reflects this' 0.63, 'correspond with' 0.50, 'keep pace' 0.40, 'mirrors' 0.36, 'match the colour' 0.16, 'reflects the diversity' 0.09 (so a demonstrative or pronoun object works best), literal 'lake reflected the light' 0.24; same-topic sentences without the verb 0.005-0.02. Fire items use reflect + this/it, keep pace with, correspond with, mirrors; the near misses drop the verb.
